svg.title: AgriRover motor wiring: ESP32 DevKit to two L298N boards and four TT motors
svg.text: Top view, front up · ESP32 DevKit V1 (30 pins) · 2 × L298N · 4 TT motors · firmware rover-mc-2.1.0
Join every GND tag: battery −, both L298N, buck, ESP32, camera.
5 V goes to ESP32 VIN and the camera. Never 12 V on the ESP32.
Each ESP32 pin goes to the L298N pin of the same colour, one wire each.
TX2 is GPIO 17. D-numbers are the GPIO numbers (D32 = GPIO 32).
Take the jumpers off ENA and ENB on both L298N (4).
Keep the 5V-EN jumper. Join every GND.
Flash rover-mc-2.1.0: it drives these pins.
Release E-stop. Rover › Test: tick the box, press Forward.
A wheel turns backward? Swap its two motor wires.
Nothing moves? Battery on, GND joined, pins as above.

Terminal positions are simplified: match the labels printed on your boards. Dashed: optional (battery sense on D34 through 100 kΩ / 22 kΩ, bumper switch from D4 to GND). Source: docs/hardware/rover_wiring.py
